items.title: How many visitors per group it takes to trust the Scenario's 12% vs. 18% result
items.description: This holds the Scenario's exact effect size (12% vs. 18%) fixed and varies only the number of visitors per group, using the same two-proportion z-test from L3. At the Scenario's actual 100 visitors per group, z stays below the 1.96 significance threshold — drag the slider up to see roughly how much more data it would take before the same effect size becomes trustworthy.
items.compute: const n = params.visitorsPerGroup; const x1 = Math.round(0.12 * n); const x2 = Math.round(0.18 * n); const pooled = (x1 + x2) / (n + n); const se = Math.sqrt(pooled * (1 - pooled) * (2 / n)); const z = Math.round(((x2 - x1) / n / se) * 100) / 100; return { z };
